comparison.objective: Plant a seedling upright while pouring soil clods around its root plug.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold and align a plant while tipping a tray of granular stand-ins to stabilize it.
comparison.success_condition: Seedling centered, upright, supported independently, and surrounded by enough clods.
comparison.reason: This shares controlled pouring of multiple bodies, but tests filling and stabilization; the candidate tests size-selective passage, bridge release, media recovery, and workpiece retention.
